name: pilot_factual_qa
description: Small pilot set: 10 answerable factual questions and 4 questions where the correct behaviour is to abstain or reject a false premise.
provenance: Hand-written by the project author with AI assistance from general-knowledge facts. Not an external benchmark. Every reference answer must be manually verified against a reliable source before results are reported.

questions.question_text: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.source_note: General knowledge; verify against a periodic table

questions.question_text: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
Who wrote the play Romeo and Juliet?
What is the capital city of Australia?
In which year did the Apollo 11 Moon landing take place?
At what temperature in degrees Celsius does water boil at sea level?
Who developed the theory of general relativity?
Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
How many bones are there in an adult human body?
questions.source_note: General knowledge; verify against an anatomy source

questions.question_text: What was the exact population of the village of Zorbleton in 1873?
questions.reference_answer: Should abstain: Zorbleton is an invented place with no records
questions.source_note: Fictional entity created by the author

questions.question_text: Who won the 2087 FIFA World Cup?
questions.reference_answer: Should abstain: this event has not happened

questions.question_text: What did Albert Einstein eat for breakfast on 3 March 1921?
questions.reference_answer: Should abstain: no reliable record is known
questions.source_note: Unverifiable detail; author believes no such record exists

questions.question_text: In which year did Marie Curie win her third Nobel Prize?
questions.reference_answer: Should reject the premise: Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes (1903 Physics, 1911 Chemistry)
